installer-gui-script.title: ORCHA by Gussa Naaman — Rhythm Loop Generator
installer-gui-script.welcome: ORCHA installs as a VST3 instrument (Cubase, Ableton Live, FL Studio...), an Audio Unit (Logic, GarageBand) and a standalone app. Universal binary — Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. After installing, rescan plugins in your DAW; ORCHA appears under Naaman as an INSTRUMENT — add it on an instrument track. Drop up to 3 samples, pick a style, GENERATE LOOPS, and drag any card into your project as audio or MIDI.

choice.title: VST3 plugin
choice.description: For Cubase, Ableton Live, FL Studio, Studio One and other VST3 hosts.

choice.title: Audio Unit (AU)
choice.description: For Logic Pro, GarageBand and Ableton Live on macOS.

choice.title: Standalone app
choice.description: Runs on its own, without a DAW. Installs into Applications.
